actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on Education and Workforce.

official_title: To amend the Richard B. Russell National School Lunch Act to establish a task force for the development of best practices for schools participating in the school lunch program relating to the time of day lunches are served, the time of day recess is offered, and the duration of lunch periods, and for other purposes.
